text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy with Mejiro Palmer—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez! It's full of rocks! Weeds everywhere!
This is never gonna end~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Fixing up the field~!
The Prez seemed troubled,
so I thought I'd lend a helping hand.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Want me to lend a hand if you'd like?
I'm actually pretty confident when it comes to working with soil~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously?! Thank you~!
Well then, don't mind if I do!

And so, I ended up helping out
with maintaining the field, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"One more time!
Take thiiiis!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pheww, digging holes seriously gets me so hyped up~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You've dug even further ahead than me!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"After all, they used to call me the 'Mejiro Hole-Digging Master'
every time I played in the mud~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Still, with a place this huge, it'll probably take a few more days.
Well, let's take our time with it!"
The next day, when I went out to the fields—

text_block_list.name: Students Adoring Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-senpai, thanks for your hard work!
We came to help out~!

text_block_list.name: Student Adoring Palmer A
text_block_list.text:
We heard you were doing farm work here,
Palmer-senpai, so we all came to cheer you on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~ seriously!? Wow, I'm so happy!
Are everyone's schedules okay? Nobody's pushing themselves?

text_block_list.name: Student Adoring Palmer A
text_block_list.text:
Everyone cleared their schedules for the whole day today!
I was talking with everyone yesterday—

text_block_list.name: Student Adoring Palmer A
text_block_list.text: Palmer-senpai always makes time to listen to our problems even when she's busy, so we decided to clear some time for her today!
The parade of unexpected helpers continued after that—

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
I brought enough rice balls and drinks for everyone,
and there are plenty of side dishes too,
so please share them among yourselves!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Hachimi~!
Nothing beats this when you're tiredâª

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you really didn't have to get all this!
Thank you so much for being so thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text: It's no problem at all! Remember Palmer-chan, when I was struggling with the new menu, you rushed over and gathered everyone's opinions, right?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I... decided that when Palmer-chan
is trying her hardest, I'd be there to help!"

text_block_list.name: Cleaning Crew
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Palmer! Backup has arrived~!
As more and more friends came to help out with the work—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, all done!
Thanks to everyone, we finished early!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
And that's that, Teio.
Why don't you go tell the President we're all done?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You just wanted to report to the President, "Look how fast I finished!", right?
That's why you worked your butt off every day, covered in mud.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
! ...Aaargh!
Man, that's so frustrating~~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh! Another letter about Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
" 'She helped me look for what I lost.
She asked so many people if they'd seen it,
and stayed with me right until curfew.' ...Huh."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even with an open suggestion box where anything about academy life could be submitted,
to think this much gratitude would gather for one specific person.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Gentle, sincere, and pure of heart—
She is one of our precious students
who quietly supports the academy from the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The President said that...?
Nah, no way, she's totally overestimating me~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was surprised
when I heard that too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still... as frustrating as it is,
I finally understand how the President feels."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The fact that everyone relies on Palmer
and thinks she's amazing is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's because she cherishes the feelings
of everyone around her, no matter who they are!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for being there to help me!
I won't lose either!
choice_data_list: You're heading straight for next Student Council President!
You're heading straight for next Student Council President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for being there to help me!
I won't lose either!
choice_data_list: You're heading straight for next Student Council President!
You're heading straight for next Student Council President!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer, you're getting in on this too...!?
Come on, enough with the compliments already!

text_block_list.name: Cleaning Staff
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I haven't praised you nearly enough yet!
So... how about we have an after-party?!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, an after-party might totally be the move!
Setting aside the praise part, of course...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you all about how amazing I am too!
So with that said... off to the cafeteria we go!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy~!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Student Council President, aren't you jumping way too far ahead...?!

text_block_list.name: Student Adoring Palmer A
text_block_list.text: No, but seriously, Student Council President isn't just a pipe dream! I'll totally help out with your campaign all the way!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, hold on! I can't just let that slide~!
The seat of the next Student Council President belongs to me~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No, it's not fallen! It definitely hasn't!
